notes:
### New Features

- Dorcel-only performance A/B trial: use a 5-second HLS live reserve instead of 0 seconds, while staying below the observed 20-25-second playlist window. This is a controlled experiment, not a confirmed fix.

### Improvements

- Reduce startup overhead by delaying nonessential RenderCapture/PNG screenshot collection during the first 60 seconds of playback. Retain the existing black recovery curtain when a capture is unavailable.
- Disable optional active HLS segment HEAD probes by default for Dorcel; keep passive manifest, player, A/V and timeline diagnostics available.
- Keep current 1024x576 frozen-frame resolution, recovery coordination and native extension dialogs unchanged.

### Bugfixes

- Prevent the same uninterrupted website outage from repeatedly reopening the frozen overlay immediately after the 90-second safety timeout. A separate later outage can still use it.
- Correct the session-wide recovered-outage audit count to recognize logged SOURCE RETURN events.

### Important

- Preserve 30m -> 1h -> 2h -> Unlimited extension timing, standard five-minute SOURCE_WINDOW behavior, PVR_COM/PVR_COM_SITE routes, expiry/standby rules and guarded restores.
- Live playback performance, Kodi-specific stalls and real HDMI screenshot quality are not proven by offline checks. Compare with the same website stream over a 30-minute test.
- If 5-second live delay worsens playback, roll back to v1.164 (0-second delay) before changing other settings.
